mapper.select: SELECT e.*, d.name as departmentName FROM EMPLOYEE e LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT d ON e.department_id = d.id ORDER BY e.id DESC
SELECT e.*, d.name as departmentName FROM EMPLOYEE e LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT d ON e.department_id = d.id WHERE e.login_id = #{loginId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EMPLOYEE (department_id, login_id, password, name, email, position, is_leader, role) VALUES (#{departmentId}, #{loginId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{email}, #{position}, #{isLeader}, #{role})
